note: All retention periods are TEST POLICIES for demonstration only - not legal requirements.

rules.description: Employee records retained 7 years after termination
Customer records retained 5 years after account closure
Supplier records retained 7 years after contract end
Support tickets retained 3 years after closure
Marketing contacts retained 2 years after unsubscribe or last engagement
Access logs retained 1 year after the access event

_toolkit_extensions: rule_id, id_column, status_column and closed_statuses were added to the supplied config. They let the engine tell an active record with no trigger yet (not eligible) from a closed record whose trigger is missing (investigate). Datasets without status_column always expect a trigger. Leap-day triggers (29 Feb) roll to 28 Feb when the due year is not a leap year.
